rows.note: Public records establish the platform, use-case governance, data-control commitments, continuity, and transition instruments.
rows.next: Acquire one named use case from data source through operational decision, human review, patient or service consequence, and outcome.
rows.fals: The platform was not materially used in any operational decision.

rows.note: The National Data Guardian records purpose limits and public engagement expectations, while the procurement records identify award criteria and public control commitments.
rows.ceil: formal public purpose and procurement thresholds
rows.next: Acquire use-case approvals, data-protection assessments, decision rules, thresholds, change control, and public-engagement outcomes.
rows.fals: The operative system used material categories or thresholds outside the stated governance path.

rows.note: The source set is institution-centered and contains no direct represented-person case or voice.
rows.next: Acquire direct case records, notices, access, correction, human review, complaint, remedy, and represented-person testimony.
rows.fals: No consequential use affects represented people or effective pre-action review is demonstrated.

rows.note: The estate distinguishes formal transition instruments from observed completion and from individual contestability.
rows.ceil: institutional timing known, subject timing unknown
rows.next: Acquire use-case notices, decision chronology, complaints, pauses, transition cutovers, and continuity effects on represented people.
rows.fals: Affected people had timely notice and effective pre-action review across consequential use cases.

rows.note: Formal public data control is a material counterweight, not proof of complete practical control.
rows.ceil: formal public data custody with unresolved technical custody
rows.next: Acquire exact contract clauses, access logs, ontology/configuration rights, audit, export, retention, deletion, and subprocessor records.
rows.fals: Observed practice materially contradicts the public data-control commitments.

rows.note: The evidence defeats a literal no-alternative claim while leaving incumbent advantage and practical enterprise substitution open.
rows.ceil: plural formal alternatives with incumbent continuity
rows.next: Acquire bidder denominator, evaluation, architecture, migration, acceptance, and post-transition product outcomes.
rows.fals: The alternative processes were nominal and did not permit viable vendors or architectures to generate evidence.

rows.note: Public governance statements imply bounded use cases and engagement before expansion, creating an exception register that must be tested.
rows.next: Acquire every use-case addition, waiver, urgent deployment, data-purpose change, approval, and challenge.
rows.fals: No material exceptions or expansions occurred outside transparent independent review.

rows.note: Official records establish transition expenditure and incumbent continuity without proving poor value or extraction.
rows.ceil: public transition cost with unresolved residual and subject error allocation
rows.next: Acquire actual transition deliverables, costs, performance, supplier revenue, public capacity, service errors, complaints, and remedies.
rows.fals: The transition produced proportionate public value, practical substitutability, and no asymmetric represented-person cost.
